name: Barbell Jump Squat
steps: Stand with a light barbell held snugly across your upper back and feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core firmly and dip quickly into a partial quarter-to-half squat.
Drive explosively upward through both feet to leap straight off the floor while pulling the bar tight into your traps.
Land softly on both feet, absorbing the impact cleanly through bent hips and knees before resetting.
tips: Pull the bar firmly down into your upper back so it never bounces off your shoulders on landing.
Use a light load and track your knees straight over your toes on every landing.
